import random, subprocess

def S(t): return ((t<<2)|(t>>6))&0xff
def Sinv(t): return ((t>>2)|(t<<6))&0xff

def F(w):
    x=[(w>>(8*i))&0xff for i in range(4)]
    y=[0]*4
    y[2]=S((x[3]^x[2]) + (x[1]^x[0]) + 1)
    y[3]=S(x[3] + y[2])
    y[1]=S((x[1]^x[0]) + y[2])
    y[0]=S(x[0] + y[1] + 1)
    return sum(y[i]<<(8*i) for i in range(4))

def Finv(w):
    y=[(w>>(8*i))&0xff for i in range(4)]
    x=[0]*4
    x[0]=(Sinv(y[0]) - y[1] - 1)&0xff
    x1x0=(Sinv(y[1]) - y[2])&0xff
    x[1]=x[0]^x1x0
    x[3]=(Sinv(y[3]) - y[2])&0xff
    x3x2=(Sinv(y[2]) - x1x0 - 1)&0xff
    x[2]=x[3]^x3x2
    return sum(x[i]<<(8*i) for i in range(4))

# check F inverse
for _ in range(200000):
    w=random.getrandbits(32)
    assert F(Finv(w))==w, "Finv fail"
    assert Finv(F(w))==w, "F fail"
print("F bijection OK")

def expand(k):
    k&=0xfffff
    return (k ^ ((k<<16)&0xffffffff) ^ ((k*12345)&0xffffffff)) & 0xffffffff

def encrypt(pt, seeds):
    key=[expand(s) for s in seeds]
    left=(pt>>32)&0xffffffff
    right=pt&0xffffffff
    right^=left
    for i in range(4):
        mixed=F((right^key[i])&0xffffffff)
        left,right=right,(left^mixed)&0xffffffff
    left^=right
    return ((right&0xffffffff)<<32)|(left&0xffffffff)

seeds=[0x12345,0xABCDE,0x0F0F0,0x99999]
pt=0x0123456789ABCDEF
print("py ct", hex(encrypt(pt,seeds)))
out=subprocess.run(["/workspace/feal",hex(pt)]+[format(s,'x') for s in seeds],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(out.stdout, out.stderr)

import sys, time, random

def S(t):
    t &= 0xff
    return ((t << 2) | (t >> 6)) & 0xff

def Sinv(t):
    t &= 0xff
    return ((t >> 2) | (t << 6)) & 0xff

def F(w):
    x0 = w & 0xff; x1 = (w >> 8) & 0xff; x2 = (w >> 16) & 0xff; x3 = (w >> 24) & 0xff
    y2 = S((x3 ^ x2) + (x1 ^ x0) + 1)
    y3 = S(x3 + y2)
    y1 = S((x1 ^ x0) + y2)
    y0 = S(x0 + y1 + 1)
    return y0 | (y1 << 8) | (y2 << 16) | (y3 << 24)

def Finv(w):
    y0 = w & 0xff; y1 = (w >> 8) & 0xff; y2 = (w >> 16) & 0xff; y3 = (w >> 24) & 0xff
    x0 = (Sinv(y0) - y1 - 1) & 0xff
    x1x0 = (Sinv(y1) - y2) & 0xff
    x1 = x0 ^ x1x0
    x3 = (Sinv(y3) - y2) & 0xff
    x3x2 = (Sinv(y2) - x1x0 - 1) & 0xff
    x2 = x3 ^ x3x2
    return x0 | (x1 << 8) | (x2 << 16) | (x3 << 24)

def expand(k):
    k &= 0xfffff
    return (k ^ ((k << 16) & 0xffffffff) ^ ((k * 12345) & 0xffffffff)) & 0xffffffff

def encrypt(pt, seeds):
    key = [expand(s) for s in seeds]
    left = (pt >> 32) & 0xffffffff
    right = pt & 0xffffffff
    right ^= left
    for i in range(4):
        mixed = F((right ^ key[i]) & 0xffffffff)
        left, right = right, (left ^ mixed) & 0xffffffff
    left ^= right
    return ((right & 0xffffffff) << 32) | (left & 0xffffffff)

def load_pairs(path):
    ps = []
    for line in open(path):
        a = line.split()
        if len(a) >= 2:
            ps.append((int(a[0]), int(a[1])))
    return ps

def attack(pairs, verbose=True):
    # pair data: L0,R0,b0,b3,b4 per pair
    data = []
    for pt, ct in pairs:
        L0 = (pt >> 32) & 0xffffffff
        R0 = pt & 0xffffffff
        b0 = R0 ^ L0
        Lout = (ct >> 32) & 0xffffffff
        Rout = ct & 0xffffffff
        b3 = Lout ^ Rout
        b4 = Lout
        data.append((L0, b0, b3, b4))

    # inverse map expanded-key -> seed
    inv = {}
    for s in range(1 << 20):
        inv[expand(s)] = s

    # choose 3 pairs for the MITM equations
    idx = [0, 1, 2]
    P = [data[i] for i in idx]

    # Build A-table over K0 seeds: key = ((A0^A1)<<32) | (A0^A2) -> k0seed
    t0 = time.time()
    A0 = [0, 0, 0]
    table = {}
    for s in range(1 << 20):
        rk = expand(s)
        for j in range(3):
            L0, b0, b3, b4 = P[j]
            A0[j] = (L0 ^ F(b0 ^ rk)) & 0xffffffff
        k = (((A0[0] ^ A0[1]) & 0xffffffff) << 32) | ((A0[0] ^ A0[2]) & 0xffffffff)
        table[k] = s
    if verbose:
        print("A table built", len(table), "in", round(time.time()-t0, 1), "s", flush=True)

    t0 = time.time()
    matches = []
    for s3 in range(1 << 20):
        rk3 = expand(s3)
        B = [0, 0, 0]
        for j in range(3):
            L0, b0, b3, b4 = P[j]
            a3 = (b4 ^ F(b3 ^ rk3)) & 0xffffffff
            B[j] = Finv(b0 ^ a3) & 0xffffffff
        k = (((B[0] ^ B[1]) & 0xffffffff) << 32) | ((B[0] ^ B[2]) & 0xffffffff)
        s0 = table.get(k)
        if s0 is not None:
            matches.append((s0, s3, B))
    if verbose:
        print("K3 scan done in", round(time.time()-t0, 1), "s, matches:", len(matches), flush=True)

    results = []
    for s0, s3, B in matches:
        rk0 = expand(s0); rk3 = expand(s3)
        L0, b0, b3, b4 = P[0]
        b1 = (L0 ^ F(b0 ^ rk0)) & 0xffffffff
        a3 = (b4 ^ F(b3 ^ rk3)) & 0xffffffff
        k1 = b1 ^ B[0]
        if k1 not in inv:
            continue
        k2 = (a3 ^ Finv(b3 ^ b1)) & 0xffffffff
        if k2 not in inv:
            continue
        seeds = (s0, inv[k1], inv[k2], s3)
        ok = all(encrypt(pt, seeds) == ct for pt, ct in pairs)
        results.append((seeds, ok))
    return results

if __name__ == "__main__":
    mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "real"
    if mode == "synthetic":
        random.seed(1234)
        seeds = (random.randrange(1 << 20), random.randrange(1 << 20),
                 random.randrange(1 << 20), random.randrange(1 << 20))
        print("true seeds", [hex(x) for x in seeds])
        pairs = [(random.getrandbits(64), 0) for _ in range(32)]
        pairs = [(pt, encrypt(pt, seeds)) for pt, _ in pairs]
        res = attack(pairs)
        print("attack results:", res)
    else:
        pairs = load_pairs("/workspace/pairs.txt")
        print("loaded", len(pairs), "pairs")
        res = attack(pairs)
        print("attack results:")
        for seeds, ok in res:
            print("  seeds", [hex(x) for x in seeds], "verified", ok)
